ANCESTORS.PARENT: FEDERAL HEALTH INSURANCE FOR THE AGED AND DISABLED

SECTION.SUBJECT: Effect of a revision.
SECTION.P: Where a revision is made in a determination or decision on the amount of program reimbursement after such determination or decision has been reopened as provided in § 405.1885, such revision shall be considered a separate and distinct determination or decision to which the provisions of §§ 405.1811, 405.1835, 405.1875 and 405.1877 are applicable. (See § 405.1801(c) for applicable effective dates.)
